description: This file defines an immutable Java class called ImmutableSizeOption that implements the SizeOption interface. It provides a fixed size value with methods for creation, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableSizeOption
classes.description: An immutable class representing a size option with a maximum size constant and methods for equality, hash code, and string conversion.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ImmutableSizeOption with the specified size.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing OptionVisitor, adhering to the visitor pattern.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object's equals method to compare size values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the size.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the size.
